scope_semantics: archive filenames encode industry schema and cr/ir report scope
revision_semantics: one current archive link per quarter with no version list
taxonomy_semantics: industry-specific taxonomy is referenced by each instance
notes: The index exposes tifrs-YYYYQn.zip from 2013Q1 onward and separate pre-IFRS tw-gaap archives.

scope_semantics: instance filenames encode ci/basi/bd/fh/ins/mim and cr/ir
availability_semantics: ZIP member timestamps are later archive rebuild times and are not company filed_at
revision_semantics: archive contains one visible current instance per company scope and not prior payload versions
taxonomy_semantics: schemaRef proves the taxonomy regime used by each instance
notes: Raw ZIPs stay outside Git and are referenced only by immutable SHA-256.

http_contract: POST step=1 co_id=<stock_id> TYPEK=all returns period scope preview and download links
scope_semantics: rows explicitly label consolidated or individual
revision_semantics: one current download per company period scope and no revision list
taxonomy_semantics: download resolves to the same period taxonomy family
notes: This surface confirms cr=consolidated and ir=individual through the displayed scope labels.

http_contract: POST JSON companyId=<stock_id> dataType=2 subsidiaryCompanyId=<empty> year=<roc_year> season=<1-4>
scope_semantics: company market and consolidated or individual report scope are displayed
availability_semantics: the response does not expose initial filed_at and its query datetime is not a source version id
revision_semantics: only current report content and correction status are visible while prior full payloads are absent
taxonomy_semantics: report links resolve to the applicable XBRL taxonomy
notes: ReviewAuditDate and response datetime are not filing availability; the 2348 2026Q1 response confirms listed market and consolidated scope only.

http_contract: POST step=1 isQuery=Y TYPEK=<sii|otc> year=<roc_year> season=<01-04> then GET step=2 CID YEAR_SEASON RID DTYPE SKEY
scope_semantics: correction rows identify company report type and correction description
availability_semantics: correction detail exposes date and SKEY but no guaranteed revision time
revision_semantics: each SKEY may link selected correction or replacement pages but complete before and after XBRL payload versions are not supplied
taxonomy_semantics: no standalone taxonomy payload is supplied by the correction table
notes: The 2816 2013Q1 4552 2025Q1 and two 2348 2026Q1 attachments are page subsets rather than full immutable report-version pairs.

http_contract: POST JSON companyId year month firstDay lastDay and POST /mops/api/t05st01_detail with enterDate serialNumber companyId marketKind
scope_semantics: announcement text may identify period and consolidated or individual scope but historical templates are not uniform
availability_semantics: official announcement date plus time provide second-level public availability for fields actually included in that announcement
revision_semantics: initial and correction announcements may expose values and state that iXBRL was reuploaded but do not provide a complete full-statement payload lineage
taxonomy_semantics: no standalone taxonomy payload is supplied by material information
notes: The 2348 2026Q1 SKEY crosswalk uses company period date and text because t05 and t56 expose no common official revision key; announcement time is not XBRL filed_at.

http_contract: POST step=1 co_id=<stock_id> year=<roc_year> redirects to doc.twse.com.tw t57sb01 and step=9 downloads the canonical PDF
scope_semantics: rows identify company period language and consolidated or individual report type
availability_semantics: the index exposes an official PDF upload timestamp to the second for each visible report row
revision_semantics: the public interface exposes one canonical filename plus the latest correction indicator and does not expose selectable before and after full PDF payload versions
taxonomy_semantics: PDF report type is scope evidence but not an XBRL taxonomy registry
notes: The upload timestamp is earlier than known correction dates in the 2816 2013Q1 and 4552 2025Q1 probes; it therefore cannot be reused as a revision filed_at. Public non-exposure does not prove that the official backend never retained prior files.

http_contract: GET official filing guidance PDF pages 21-22
scope_semantics: the guidance separately describes formatted financial-statement and electronic-book correction workflows
revision_semantics: correct formatted data are resubmitted while an uploaded electronic book is deleted before a new electronic book is uploaded; no public immutable before and after payload archive is specified
notes: The guidance proves that the public current-file workflow is not an append-only version contract; it does not prove whether the official backend retains deleted files internally.

taxonomy_semantics: taxonomy packages define regime-specific concepts and must not be mixed across industries
notes: Taxonomy evidence supports parsing but cannot authorize historical PIT use.

availability_semantics: the public product page does not publish whether L01 contains received_at public_available_at or only delivery processing metadata
revision_semantics: the public product page does not promise revision sequence supersedes ids immutable payload hashes or historical replay

notes: L01 may be a delivery crosswalk only; its written schema and sample must prove any XBRL-specific availability or revision binding.
